description: Source code for WebSocket HTTP/3 handshake stream implementation in Chromium, handling WebSocket handshake over HTTP/3 with methods for request registration, response handling, and stream management.

classes.name: WebSocketHttp3HandshakeStream
classes.description: Implements WebSocket handshake over HTTP/3, managing request/response lifecycle, headers, and stream state.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the handshake.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with priority, net log, and timestamp.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends WebSocket handshake request with headers and manages stream adapter.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers, validates response if complete.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream and disconnects adapter.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles received response headers, updates response info, and triggers validation.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles stream closure with error status.

methods.name: ReceiveAdapterAndStartRequest
methods.description: Assigns stream adapter and initiates request headers write.

methods.name: ValidateResponse
methods.description: Validates the response code and headers for WebSocket upgrade.

methods.name: ValidateUpgradeResponse
methods.description: Validates upgrade response headers, subprotocols, and extensions.
